title: Committed-input admission refuses a clean Windows checkout made with system core.autocrlf=true
outcome: A worktree checked out on a Windows host whose system Git config sets core.autocrlf=true is either admitted as clean by the launcher's committed-input check when its content equals the commit, or refused with a message that names line-ending conversion and the supported checkout setting. It is never refused as an unexplained dirty checkout.
acceptance: Committed-input admission refuses a clean Windows checkout made with system core.autocrlf=true is done
